channel.title: KlagonOrg Blog
channel.description: Mastery of change in the digital age — practical guides for Ghana's youth on lifelong learning, digital transformation, thinking skills, building visions, and making things happen.

item.title: Volunteering in Ghana: Build Skills, Experience, and Connections
item.description: Volunteering is the fastest free way to build real work experience in Ghana. Here's how to volunteer smartly, record it, and turn it into jobs and references.

item.title: Why You Don't Finish Things — and How to Start Finishing
item.description: Projects die from scope, not laziness. Learn the shrink-to-ship rule, the 90% rule, and public deadlines to actually finish what you start.

item.title: How to Build Habits That Stick: The Habit Stacking Method
item.description: Willpower runs out. Habit stacking doesn't. Learn how to attach new habits to existing routines, start in two minutes, and never miss twice.

item.title: How to Write a CV With No Work Experience (First Job)
item.description: No job history? No problem. Here's how to write a first CV in Ghana using projects, volunteering, skills, and education — with a structure that actually gets calls.

item.title: A 5-Year Plan Template for Young Ghanaians (Free Download)
item.description: Dreams without plans are wishes. Here's a practical 5-year plan template young Ghanaians can fill in this weekend — destination, milestones, skills, money, and habits.

item.title: How to Make Better Decisions When You Have Little Time
item.description: Decision fatigue is real. Learn the 10-10-10 rule, the 3-wickets filter, and a simple decision table to make better choices faster — career, money, and life.

item.title: How to Spot Fake News and Misinformation Online
item.description: Misinformation spreads faster than truth on WhatsApp and social media. Learn the STOP test to verify any story, claim, or viral post before you share it.

item.title: Protect Yourself Online in Ghana: The Scam Guide You Need
item.description: From 'MTN rewards' to fake loan apps and marketplace prepayments — how to spot the most common online scams in Ghana and protect your money and data.

item.title: WhatsApp Business for Ghana Sellers: A Complete Starter Guide
item.description: How to set up WhatsApp Business, build a catalog, manage orders, and turn status updates into sales — a practical guide for small Ghana businesses and traders.

item.title: Learn a New Skill With Only Your Phone: A 30-Day Plan
item.description: You don't need a laptop or paid courses. Learn skills like AI tools, video editing, or digital marketing on one smartphone with a simple 30-day plan.

item.title: How to Study for Exams in Ghana: A System That Actually Works
item.description: A practical 6-week exam preparation system built around past questions, active recall, and a simple daily routine — for BECE, WASSCE, and university students.

item.title: How to Take Notes That Actually Help You Learn
item.description: Most notes are written once and never read again. Here's a simple capture-condense-recall note system that turns your note-taking into real learning.

item.title: How Learning Skills Compounds: The Math of Becoming Remarkable
item.description: Skills multiply, not just add. See the actual math of stacking complementary skills — and why unremarkable consistency beats raw talent over time.

item.title: What Does It Mean to 'Find Your Purpose'? A Realistic Guide

item.title: From Idea to First Sale: A Practical 30-Day Launch Plan
item.description: Your idea doesn't need perfecting — it needs a first sale. This 30-day launch plan takes you from rough concept to paying customer, step by step.

item.title: How to Build Confidence and Overcome Self-Doubt (Practical Guide)

item.description: Your online activity is your public CV. Learn how to build a digital footprint that opens doors — and avoid the mistakes that close them.

item.title: Jua Kali Thinking: How Small-Scale Skills Build Big Success
item.description: The garages, kitchens, and roadside workshops are secret universities. Why practical, hands-on skills — not certificates — are the fastest route to income for young Africans.

item.title: How to Ask Better Questions: The Thinking Skill Nobody Teaches
item.description: Behind every breakthrough is a better question. Learn the practical types of questions that unlock learning, problem-solving, and real conversations.

item.title: Digital Marketing Basics: Promote Anything Without a Big Budget
